mapper.select:
select pp.id as id, pp.year as year, pp.image_url as imageUrl, pp.name as name, pp.product_status as productStatusName, pp.category as category, pp.grade as grade, pp.charge_name as chargeName, pp.plan_survey_date as planSurveyDate, pp.plan_project_approval_date as planProjectApprovalDate, pp.plan_first_mass_stock_in_date as planFirstMassStockInDate, pp.plan_listing_date as planListingDate, pp.project_approval_date as projectApprovalDate, pp.first_mass_stock_in_date as firstMassStockInDate, pp.listing_date as listingDate, pp.create_user_name as createUserName, pp.create_time as createTime from product_plan pp
pp.is_deleted = false
and pp.product_status = ''
and pp.product_status in ('3','4','5','6')
and pp.product_status in ('4','5','6')
and pp.name like concat('%',#{params.name},'%')
and
string_to_array(pp.charge_id,',') && string_to_array(#{item}, ',')
and pp.category_id = #{params.categoryId}
and pp.plan_survey_date_begin >= #{params.planSurveyDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_survey_date_end <= #{params.planSurveyDateEnd}::timestamp
and pp.plan_project_approval_date_begin >= #{params.planProjectApprovalDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_project_approval_date_begin <= #{params.planProjectApprovalDateEnd}::timestamp
and pp.plan_first_mass_stock_in_date_begin >= #{params.planFirstMassStockInDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_first_mass_stock_in_date_end <= #{params.planFirstMassStockInDateEnd}::timestamp
and pp.plan_listing_date_begin >= #{params.planListingDateBegin}::timestamp
and pp.plan_listing_date_end <= #{params.planListingDateEnd}::timestamp
